requirements.summary: Ensure a clean frontend rebuild/redeploy succeeds without feature changes while preserving public-route access and admin gating.
acceptanceCriteria: A fresh build completes successfully for both frontend and backend (no TypeScript or Motoko compilation errors).
The redeployed app loads successfully on the production URL and renders the landing page without requiring authentication.
Public routes remain accessible without authentication: `/`, `/products`, `/product/:id`, `/cart`, `/checkout`, `/request-quote`.
Admin routes remain gated behind Internet Identity authentication and admin role checks: `/admin/*`.

file_operations.description: Tighten the rebuild/redeploy checklist to explicitly cover a clean frontend rebuild (remove caches/artifacts), verify SPA deep-link behavior, and validate the public/admin route access rules remain unchanged. (No user-facing feature changes.)

Add a small, deterministic script to perform a clean frontend rebuild (e.g., remove build artifacts/caches, reinstall dependencies, run typecheck/build) to support reliable redeploys without altering app behavior.

Add a lightweight, manual smoke-test checklist for verifying public routes load without authentication and `/admin/*` remains gated behind Internet Identity + admin role checks after redeploy. Include references to current routes already wired in frontend/src/App.tsx and current admin gating in frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminLayout.tsx.
